notes.title: August update
notes.notes:
Additions:


Added new handicaps and skills

Added music

Added wild animals

Added harvestable wild plants

Added agility implants


Fixes:


Performance improvements

Some clone behavior improvements

Fixed issue with damage not being calculated correctly

Effects now clear when enemies respawn

Landmines now explode when shot

Fixed a bug where Nexus was not finishing construction properly

Fixed some more instances where clones would get stuck

Fixed nitrogen pump audio not stopping when no power

Game now keeps the custom resolution settings consistently

Fixed a bug where a silhouette of an enemy would continue to burn

Game now saves landmines and state of switched (on/off) objects

Streamer laser now hits where the crosshair dot is pointing

Increased flashlight brightness

Enemy missile mechs do not destroy themselves while firing anymore, armor and HP bumped
